question.text: SEBI renamed the "Dividend" option in mutual funds to "IDCW" in 2021. What does IDCW stand for?

explanation.text: The Logic: Effective April 1, 2021, SEBI renamed the "Dividend" option to "Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal" (IDCW). The name signals that the amount distributed may include both an income-distribution component and a capital-withdrawal component. The Trap: Remember the acronym precisely — "Income Distribution CUM Capital Withdrawal." The word "cum" means "along with," indicating the distribution combines income with a return of capital. Note: The renaming is associated with the workbook's treatment of distributions as split between income distribution and capital distribution.
